tasks.title: Manifest generator + CI integration in releases/ repo
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-rpi-imager/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/imager.feature}. SECOND: implement releases/scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh that walks the Packer build outputs, computes sha256 + size per variant, assembles pi-imager-manifest.json per the schema in design.md. (REQ-300/301/313) Hook into the existing releases CI on tag-build. (REQ-302/303) Upload manifest to get.cubeos.app + verify sha256 matches actual published artifact before exposure.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd releases && shellcheck scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh && bash scripts/generate-pi-imager-manifest.sh --test-fixtures && jq -e '.subitems | length >= 5' tmp/manifest.json

tasks.title: Manifest signing + signature publishing
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-rpi-imager/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: implement releases/scripts/sign-manifest.sh using the CubeOS release key (REQ-314). The key lives in a CI variable vault entry CUBEOS_RELEASE_PRIVATE_KEY (existing). Sign with openssl pkeyutl ECDSA. Publish signature alongside manifest at get.cubeos.app/pi-imager-manifest.json.sig. Document signature verification recipe in release-notes template.
tasks.acceptance_test: cd releases && bash scripts/sign-manifest.sh tmp/manifest.json && bash scripts/verify-signature.sh tmp/manifest.json tmp/manifest.json.sig

tasks.title: Pi Foundation submission + post-submission monitoring
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/003-rpi-imager/{requirements.md, design.md}. SECOND: this is a one-shot operational task. (REQ-307) Submit https://get.cubeos.app/pi-imager-manifest.json to the Pi Foundation via their listed submission form (URL in release-notes template). Track the submission in YouTrack CUBEOS-* issue. Once listed: (REQ-308) write a CI assertion that fails the release pipeline if the canonical manifest URL path drifts. Also write a daily cron in scripts/ that fetches the Pi Foundation catalog and verifies CubeOS is still listed; alerts to Matrix on absence.
